reason: The price is not the problem, ₹999 a month is nothing for my outlets, but I have never heard of this and no owner or distributor I know is using it. I will not move my billing and customer data onto something nobody around me has tried.
objection: If the app stops billing on a busy Sunday with the chairs full, who picks up the phone and fixes it right then? A training visit at setup does not answer that.
would_change_my_mind: Another salon owner I know, or my product distributor, running it for a few months and telling me support actually shows up on weekends.
